title: Lightly Pan-Fried Canadian Fish Hash
description: A savory, flaky, and comforting Canadian dish made with pan-fried fish and potatoes, perfect for a sick day.

ingredients.name: 1 pound cod fillets, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Fresh cod or other firm white fish works well.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup cold unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
1/2 teaspoon salt
ingredients.notes: Use flaky sea salt for best flavor.

ingredients.name: 2 large potatoes, peeled and diced
ingredients.notes: Use high-starch potatoes like Russet or Idaho.

instructions: Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, dill weed, salt, and pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cod pieces to the skillet and cook until they start to flake apart, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and stir to combine with the cod and vegetables.
Continue cooking the mixture for another 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender and the fish is cooked through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with additional salt and pepper if needed.
Serve the fish hash hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
